ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe presents a high-intensity base with dense vertical low-intensity linear streaks. Right lobe is primarily low-intensity black with small high-intensity patches near the trailing edge. A distinct low-intensity circular ring is localized in the lower-left region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 35-45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrated boundary with irregular peak-to-valley pixel amplitudes across the entire trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve with upward-sweeping distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-contrast, irregular circular pixel groupings (barnacle colonization) localized on the distal tips and along the lateral edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant density of unaligned vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the left lobe, appearing as low-intensity marks on a high-intensity background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological accretion (barnacles) on both distal tips; distinct circular ring-scar on the lower-left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity specular water spray occluding the lower-central and lower-right regions of the right fluke lobe.
